title: admission: answer its provider notices

status.reason: reopened: op-declarations PR 289 (security, BOB 4 Nov) puts the T53 credential acts (aiaccountadd, aiownadd, aiaccountremove, aiaccountswitch, aikeyenter, aikeyseal, aikeycloudflare) in REAUTH_ACTS. bio-plane/test/m/admission/doors.test.mjs R19 (line 157) then fails: it expects NOT_AN_ADMIN for every account op in REAUTH_ACTS asked by a non-admin, but by admission R29 aiaccountadd/aiaccountremove/aiaccountswitch are not administrators' own acts, so admission rightly answers REAUTH_DUE. Admission's code is right: narrow R19's test condition to administrators' own acts (as R29 defines them), and add a case that a non-admin asking aiaccountadd without a fresh password gets REAUTH_DUE. No code change in src/admission unless your requirements demand it. Do not consolidate (deferred to after the first release).
